item.description:
More clarity. More control.
• Understand uncertain findings with local evidence, publisher details and clear next steps. • Quarantine supported files, restore them, or permanently remove quarantined files after confirmation. • Connect your IRIS account for one monthly manual scan on Free or unlimited scans on Pro. Cleanup and updates stay available on both plans. • Pro can enable background checks of changes in Downloads, Desktop and user LaunchAgents while IRIS is running. This does not monitor every file or block execution. • A brighter purple and mint design, with saved results and trusted choices preserved.

A smoother start and easier updates.
• Fixes a ZIP packaging issue that could show a “damaged app” warning after unpacking the download. • Adds Check for Updates to the IRIS menu, menu-bar companion and About page. • Checks for signed updates automatically, with an optional automatic-download setting. • Verifies updates before unpacking them and waits for an active scan to finish before restarting. • Keeps your saved review, trusted items and dashboard connection.
